ops.title: tooling-notation lane: #247 released in v12.77.1 and #250 in v12.78.1; v12.78.1 is installed on all five surfaces
ops.body: Releases: v12.77.1 (e16b676a, #247 tooling-lane ccx annotation + Confirm on repeat dispatch), v12.78.1 (6f3650fa, #250 github-quota refusals only from failed calls/stderr; fixes papercut 119a273). Installed 12.78.1 on: brew Cellar, helper app (~/Applications/Captain Hook.app, helper status v12.78.1 ok), daemonkit tool env ~/.daemonkit/tools/capt-hook/12.78.1, uv tool (uv tool install --force --refresh-package capt-hook capt-hook==12.78.1; without --refresh-package uv's cached index rejected the version), and plugin cache 12.78.1. Helper deploy at 12.77.1 never converged: about 30 back-to-back package-install runs failed with 'live processes remain on the deployment's executables' because short-lived hook capt-hookd execs from busy sessions kept running from the old deployment (task 39ffc87). At 19:27 PT the 12.78.1 deploy landed on the second try; the first failed with 'verify signed bundle: context deadline exceeded'.
